stories.title: Migrate proof retention to per-kind days

fields.summary: As a quality architect, I want retention_days migrated to a retention per artifact kind, so that existing configs keep their meaning.
fields.completion_goal:
1. [api-trace] state: a config with `[proof] retention_days = 90`; expected: `aayu config show` reports 90 days for every kind after the migration
2. [api-trace] state: `aayu upgrade` on that config, then its rollback; expected: the file is restored byte for byte
fields.scenario: Load a v1 config, run the migration, show the config, then roll the migration back.
fields.environment: local checkout with synthetic fixtures; never production

fields.summary: As a quality architect, I want purge to drop each artifact kind after its own retention, so that recordings go before reports.
fields.completion_goal: 1. [api-trace] state: a ledger with a 40-day-old recording and report, recordings kept 30 days and reports 365; expected: purge tombstones the recording and keeps the report
fields.scenario: Push two packs dated 40 days ago, set the retentions, and run purge.
fields.environment: local checkout with synthetic fixtures; never production

fields.summary: As a human, I want `aayu proof purge --kind recording`, so that I can purge one kind by hand.
fields.completion_goal: 1. [api-trace] state: `aayu proof purge --kind recording --dry-run` on the fixture ledger; expected: only recordings are listed for purge
fields.scenario: Run the command with --dry-run against the fixture ledger.
fields.environment: local checkout with synthetic fixtures; never production

stories.title: List ledger packs through the API

fields.summary: As purge, I want to list packs through the GitHub contents API, so that a scheduled run needs no full clone.
fields.completion_goal: 1. [api-trace] state: the fake GitHub serving a ledger tree with three packs; expected: the listing returns the three pack paths
fields.scenario: Serve a recorded ledger tree and list it.
fields.environment: local checkout with synthetic fixtures; never production

fields.summary: As a quality architect, I want purge to run weekly in Actions, so that retention holds without anyone remembering it.
fields.completion_goal: 1. [api-trace] state: the purge workflow dispatched on a scratch repository with an expired recording; expected: the run tombstones it and succeeds
fields.scenario: Dispatch the workflow on a scratch repository and read the ledger after it.
fields.environment: local checkout with synthetic fixtures; never production
